Gael Monfils Concludes Grand Slam Tennis Career at US Open

French tennis player Gael Monfils has played his final Grand Slam match, losing to Learner Tien in the second round of the US Open. Monfils, 40, was defeated by the 20-year-old Tien with a score of 6-3, 6-4, 6-3. Following his final shot, Monfils received a standing ovation. He plans to retire from professional tennis at the end of the year.
